dedupeText: starlit studio portrait layout 80s aesthetic slab serif hand drawn lettering starry background group portrait navy and white contrast between the rigid geometric header and organic footer centrality of the group subjects within a dark textured field horizontal alignment of the subjects heads creating a rhythmic line framing effect of the white borders against the dark central image three tier layout slab serif header starry portrait hand inked footer

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier vertical composition featuring a central group portrait of four men against a dark, starry backdrop, sandwiched between a clean white header with bold slab-serif text and a white footer with expressive, ink-like hand-lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the rigid geometric header and organic footer
Centrality of the group subjects within a dark, textured field
Horizontal alignment of the subjects' heads creating a rhythmic line
Framing effect of the white borders against the dark central image
coreInvariants: White horizontal bands at top and bottom
Dark, speckled or starry background texture
Combination of formal and informal typographic styles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four men positioned mid-ground, waist-up, occupying the central 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the navy suit, acting as the focal point of the group.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the bold header, through the faces of the subjects, to the expressive script at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the white header and footer to provide breathing room for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and charcoal in the central image and text.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the top and bottom framing bands.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted skin tones and soft highlights on clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the central image with high value contrast between the white borders and the dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a desaturated, moody central photograph

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy Slab Serif and Expressive Script
letterConstructionRules: Header: Extra-bold, wide-set slab serifs with thick blocky terminals.
Footer: Irregular, brush-like strokes with varying thickness and rough edges.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Slab serif 'R' and 'B' have large, rounded bowls and heavy horizontal feet.
Script 'd' and 'k' in the footer have elongated, jagged ascenders.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Juxtaposition of industrial geometric stability (top) with raw human expression (bottom).

preserve: Hand-drawn texture of the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure of the header.
Captures the ink-like, expressive quality of the footer.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of four men in dark suits against a dark navy background with subtle white star-like speckles. Leave wide white horizontal margins at the very top and bottom of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a bold, wide slab-serif title in the top white margin and a rough, hand-inked script title in the bottom white margin.

verificationChecks: Check that the header text is perfectly centered and all-caps.
Ensure the footer text has a visible 'ink bleed' or rough texture.
Verify the central image has a dark, atmospheric quality with subtle star textures.

adjustableVariables: Specific color of the header text (blue-grey vs black)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Clear separation of the three horizontal tiers
High-contrast between text and white background

postGenerationChecks: Is the slab serif heavy enough?
Does the bottom text look hand-drawn?
Is the central image properly framed by the white bands?
Are the subjects' expressions neutral or slightly smiling?
recipe.reuseFormula: Three-tier layout + Slab Serif Header + Starry Portrait + Hand-inked Footer.
